title: Matched PPO pilots and a rigid-toe CAD proposal
summary: Both 50-update direct PPO pilots completed but failed all 48 quiet trials. CAPS is the unqualified preview candidate. A separate editable Ø30 / R15 rigid-toe sketch preserves the distinction between axial leg length and migrating ground contact. Major walking, omnidirectional, terrain/perception and surveying checkpoints remain the poster’s main structure.
next: Inspect the actual CAPS recording and independently verify the implementation audit before selecting the next learning intervention.
